definitions.cold: New Chromium context; empty HTTP cache and IndexedDB. Timed import starts at form submit after hydration. Module download/evaluation is recorded separately.
definitions.warm: Preloaded module in same browser context with local browser caches; timed import starts at form submit after navigation/hydration.
definitions.readableMs: Form submit capture to MutationObserver finding exact text in actual React reader. Not a compositor paint timestamp.
definitions.renderObservationMs: Form submit to second requestAnimationFrame after DOM text observed. Rendering opportunity, not device display/compositor proof.
definitions.network: fetch dispatch to response headers plus Resource Timing response completion. Includes injected fixture/server work; do not sum overlapping server/client durations.
definitions.hashing: Real SHA-256 of synthetic original bytes in local Node fixture server, inside original commit; not production Workers DigestStream cost.
definitions.persistence: In-memory local fixture record/result update and acknowledgement. No R2/D1 or durable network storage measured.
definitions.delay: 3333 ms intentionally added to each of three original storage responses; demonstrates dependency, does not reproduce/attribute the reported hosted ten seconds.
definitions.pdfOcr: Worker construction and WebAssembly API counters are observed, not assigned zero-duration guesses.

limitations: Private Site authentication unavailable in this task; no live Site timing or deployment.
Desktop headless Chromium only; no iPhone/iPad Safari measurements.
Baseline and candidate bundle actual workspace/upload-client code; authentication/server storage endpoints use synthetic local HTTP fixture.
Node cold means fresh module identity within one process; does not include OS process startup.
Suggested integration patch is applied only in temporary benchmark source; UX owner must integrate and revalidate.
checks: Exact readable output appears while original storage is pending, with saving status and no premature retry prompt.
original save failure: exact readable/exportable result survives IndexedDB reload; retry succeeds
result save failure: exact readable/exportable result survives IndexedDB reload; retry succeeds without duplicate original
Cancel during text preparation aborts the active job before any upload.
All measured text imports create zero Workers and invoke zero WebAssembly compilation/instantiation APIs; exact Markdown downloads match input.
